say:1:1033468001:1.text: Correct! I've thought it through... It has always been the Dark Forest that I want to protect.
say:1:1033468001:1.source_cn: 没错，我想明白了。一直以来，我想要守护的都是薄暮丛林。
say:1:1033468001:1.male: Correct! I've thought it through... It has always been the Dark Forest that I want to protect.
say:1:1033468001:1.female: Correct! I've thought it through... It has always been the Dark Forest that I want to protect.

say:2:1033468002:1.text: I followed Master Eomir because I thought he was the one who would lead the Thorned Guards to keep our homeland safe.
say:2:1033468002:1.source_cn: 我之前追随伊米尔贤者，也是因为我相信他可以带领荆棘保护...
say:2:1033468002:1.male: I followed Master Eomir because I thought he was the one who would lead the Thorned Guards to keep our homeland safe.
say:2:1033468002:1.female: I followed Master Eomir because I thought he was the one who would lead the Thorned Guards to keep our homeland safe.

say:3:1033468003:1.text: But he let down our trust, and now many Thorned Guards are lost...
say:3:1033468003:1.source_cn: 然而他却辜负了我们的信任，无数的荆棘因此迷茫……
say:3:1033468003:1.male: But he let down our trust, and now many Thorned Guards are lost...
say:3:1033468003:1.female: But he let down our trust, and now many Thorned Guards are lost...

say:4:1033468004:1.text: Seeing how trust in others ends in betrayal, I decide to hold trust close to my heart.
say:4:1033468004:1.source_cn: 既然信任他人迎来了背叛。我选择将信任放于心底。
say:4:1033468004:1.male: Seeing how trust in others ends in betrayal, I decide to hold trust close to my heart.
say:4:1033468004:1.female: Seeing how trust in others ends in betrayal, I decide to hold trust close to my heart.
